text: I think these are some of the best tacos in SB! They are very fancy but delicious.  Individually they are a little pricey but I recommend the triple play (3 tacos of your choice and a side of chips for under $10). Its also a great place to bring kids,  they have batting cages, air hockey, and cornhole.

paulene was the absolute worst. she never once checked up on us. i'm pretty sure that is your job paulene. clearly you do not deserve to be working here, but ur service was awful, and you treated my friend and i like complete crap. shame on you paulene.

I called and placed an order for pickup. After coming in the order was still not ready, so I waited a total of almost an hour. I couldn't wait any longer so I ended up canceling the order and leaving without my food. Absolutely unacceptable!

The location/view gives this place a 3 star rating. 
I ordered a beer and it wasn't very cold. I also ordered the conch fritters appetizer and it was barely any conch in it. The sauce and seasoning was good but I hardly tasted any conch. I got a oyster shot it was alright ..

If I could give this a zero, I would.  This was the worst service I've received in my entire life.  I was visiting with a coworker when we realized that our appetizer was still not out.......60 minutes it came out and the pizza came out at the same time.  The appetizer platter was burnt and we were unable to eat it.  The pizza was the worst pizza I've ever had.  I took one bite and it felt slimy in my mouth.  I took one bite from another piece and it had the same slimy texture.  We left the entire pizza there and paid the bill and left.  We did not receive one apology for the late app or the nasty pizza.  This place has had their interior updated, as it looks like it is straight out of the 70's.  The best part (sarcastic) I got food poisoning from this place and I've been very sick for the past 15 hours.   Be smart......pick someplace else to go.....you will thank me later.
Small shop near USF that has an assortment of different sweet and savory baked goods. Good prices and overall good quality. I'll definitely come again to try there different baked goods

Love this place! I brought my family here for the first time and everything was amazing! It wasn't very busy at the time we came in so it was very intimate, our server Angel was very helpful with explaining the menu and how the choices work. We shared all the meats and veggies.we had a great time and will be back 

p.s thank you for streaming bts :)
The pizza was very good here. Will definitely eat here again soon. Love how they do the crust and the extra cheese and pepperoni pizza is to die for here.

The reason why I rated this place a 2 star was because their lack of consistency. The first time we went my steak was amazing it was juicy pink just like I asked however I didn't get any eggs on my salad like the menu described. This last time it got a bit worse, I ordered a steak expecting it to be the same like last time it was cooked with little pink and I asked for medium not medium well my steak was dry. I ordered a side of broccoli and there was no garlic butter on that as the menu described just like there was no eggs in my garden salad last time.  The fries were prepared way before the main course and were stale and not even warm by the time I got my dinner. My mom called to let them know we felt the dinner was not worth the amount we paid for and the owner did not offer to get us a comp dinner or anything to make up for this bad experience.  My steak was so dry that that I didn't even take the remaining home!! waste of money in our opinion for this visit on a weekday and I definitely won't continue supporting a steak house that there is no consistency or offers to make it better and ownership when the food clearly wasn't meeting expectations that night period.  Again will not return to a restaurant if they cannot keep it consistent with the way they say the food is on the menu and it doesn't actually come out that way. Not worth the big hype.

So we got special passes to come over to the gate side of the airport since we weren't flytrill the next day just to try this place. Rad some really good reviews for it. 

Staff is super friendly and the menu sounds awesome!  

We were told at 20 to 8 that they were switching to the in flight menu which is a lot smaller so get there before 730 to get the good stuff 

We started with with some fried green tomatoes. Really good. The sauce had a little kick to it.  

We then ordered the duck cob and skirt steak. It was a lot of food but we managed. All of it was really good. Steak was cooked perfect and was so full of flavors. 

Service was great even though it was late and everyone was packing up to leave the airport.  

Definitely going to check out there main place in Tampa.

Can't say enough good things about Bartolino's Osteria. Friendly fast service, family owned, tasty cocktails and solid italian food for years. 

I am certainly a fan and recommend you trying it out! Also great for parties and large groups!
Food is great but gave it a four Star because it is a little warm inside every time I go. Now, I just order to go...problem solved!

Freebirds is a great choice for a filling lunch/dinner in IV! The setup is very similar to Chipotle, in that you choose an item (burrito, tacos, etc.) and then customize it with meat/beans/veggies. 

I absolutely love the nachos (portions are huge though, so split with 1-2 people)! If I'm alone, I usually end up getting the chicken bowl which is pretty good too, as everything's always fresh. If you're in the mood for something smaller, ask for a tostada bowl (not on the menu). It's similar to a burrito bowl, but smaller (& cheaper ~ closer to $6 instead of $10) and has a tostada on the bottom.

The line can get a bit long, especially during dinner time, but it moves fairly quickly. I do think it's a bit on the pricier end for the amount of food you're getting though.

I love this Starbucks location! Mary at the drive thru is always super friendly and asks how my day is going. I always appreciate that! 

It gets fairly busy during the weekday with lots of people getting work done, so outlets are sometimes at a premium and finding a table mid-day is sometimes difficult.

Obviously Starbucks is a chain but this location is fantastic-- accurate on the order and a friendly staff that makes it seem like a neighborhood coffee shop. Keep up the good work!

Use to be very good, go there a lot for quick pick up. but half year ago food suddenly get very very salty, new and younger employee make mistake a lot(ask for no cheese, commonly forget), recently food taste more normal again, and Texas burger is pretty good. But still, often being disappointed if I order meals(so I get 3 dollar meal, only cheeseburger so they don't messed up, forget to remove cheese still thought. the old triple cheese burger is very salty.

Whenever i have time on the weekends i always stop at Yannis's for the classic Gyro. I have been to Greece twice and this has been by far the closest if not better than some i've had in Greece. I usually order 2 one to eat then and another for later because thats how good it is. His catering business is also top notch as well
I went here for my anniversary dinner with my wife and we sat at the bar.  Our chef was awesome and he made the sushi perfectly!
What an amazing experience! We have been here before but tonight was a whole other experience- the best restaurant experience in a long time. Thank you Paul!!! You made this night sooo enjoyable!
Used to like this place, cheesesteaks are like dipped in grease it's terrible. I'll never order from this place again. Do yourself a favor and go get a cheesesteak from angelos or the pork shack.

Overall nice ambience - excellent food.  We came with an eight tear old - inquired about a children's menu.  Instead of pointing out what we might enjoy, waiter gave us the "he shouldn't be here" look and attitude.  "Service" afterwards was downhill - rude - worst I've ever encountered - he basically threw everything at us.  To top it off, one of us got sick.  We'll never go back!

I normally order pizza from this Domino's location, but had a terrible experience tonight which will ensure that I will never use them again. My husband placed an order, the tracker hadn't updated, and after 45 minutes, he decided to call. We were told that the manager had called us to tell us our order was cancelled (no one had called), and that they were not able to deliver our order due to a problem with the driver being stuck downtown due to a fire. Not sure why there was only one driver on assignment for tonight. When my husband asked to speak to a manager, the manager was wildly rude to him. He told my husband we would have to come in the store to receive our cancelation receipt (the charge is still on our account). My husband said he wouldn't be able to come in to collect a receipt (hence why we ordered a delivery), and the manager immediately flipped on him and told him he wasn't going to go "back and forth" with him. The manager contradicted himself, vehemently denying he told my husband that he would have to come in to collect a receipt, then threatened to hang up on him. Professional. Although the manager spoke with my husband, it was on speaker phone and everyone in our home (we were having a party) heard this unfortunate exchange.

This individual should not be in management. He offered no apology for this inconvenience, and was extremely defensive when my husband expressed displeasure with our order being charged and cancelled without notification, which seems l

Ordered dinner for take out, as we were gifted a gift card for $60.  When we called we were told it would be 25 min..  When we arrived to pick up our food we were told it would be another 15 min..  Got home and food seemed as though it had been sitting a long time.  My son had ordered calamari and said they gave him fried crumbs of breading with little to no calamari inside (12.00 appetizer).  The capresse salad was warm and not cold like it should be.  The shrimp pizza was ok and the wings were good.  We won't be back.  I mean...for $65.00 it should be amazing.  It was not.  Sorry Titos.  U don't have our future business.  Not impressed.
Kitchen87 is my favorite breakfast spot!  Their daily specials are creative and the staff is so friendly.

This is the best juice place in the northwest (better than Seattle and Portland places even) but one thing I would love to see is a "weekly rotational" juice. I'm sure the staff are back there mixing up their own favorites anyway maybe you could let them put a weekly rotational out every Monday for us avid fans that go there 1-2x per week
Great bar great music amazing good. Dan our waiter was amazing!! Love the new location
Their Cuban is absolutely delicious! Overall a great place to grab some food and beer. Always have had excellent, attentive service.

Wonderful place to watch the sunset!  Asian inspired as they offer a variety of dishes and daily specialty rolls. Nice cocktails and their wines are affordable especially because of their prime location, they could charge more. Thank goodness they don't! 
Very hip and modern place to dine, great for large parties or couples who want to enjoy eating by the beach. 
Service was great and the food came out pretty fast. Would recommend for sunset dining and kite bites.

This is my favorite costa vida location! I probably go here once a week for the steak salad. They make the tortillas fresh, which is the best part in my opinion! The food is always fresh and the service is very nice and quick. Great spot if you are on your lunch break.
Best steaks in Philly..this is pure must go to every trip here. Always friendly staff and easy to get to.

In my 37 years on this beautiful planet, I've never tried Thai food. I have a rather sensitive stomach so I've always steered clear of unknown foods. East Asian cuisine is my true soul food but after trying this southern Asian cuisine, this may be one of my go-to spots in town for my soul food. You can tell these folks put their heart into this food. I could taste the love & I was not disappointed. My hubby got #60 (soft shell crab w green curry) & I got the #40 (ginger lovers). I'm glad we all got something different so I could try things in small quantities. I could eat ginger all day long & it's very helpful to my belly but I seriously could not put down my hubby's green curry soup. It was devine! We also got the crab rangoon & while I'm not a fan of scallions in my crab rangoon, their homemade dipping sauce was incredible! I could drink that alone, HAHA!! You have our business & we welcome you to our small town!

Cafe Intermezzo is a hidden gem in downtown Nashville! I go almost daily for the best almond milk lattes in town. They have the highest quality coffee and can make it any way you want. You can sit at the bar and gaze in wonderment at all the beautiful decor, or sit at a table and dine to beautiful jazz in the romantic candlelight. The food is delicious! And don't forget to stop at the amazing dessert case for some Italy imported tiramisu!

First time in Philly and we landed around 9 pm so there weren't too many things open. We found this place on Yelp and decided to walk over to it. Pretty cool vibe had plenty of TVs to watch the game. Fairly good pricing I guess. The salad was great and the salt and pepper wings actually were tasty!  Pretty decent service.

Great neighborhood sports bar.  Flatbread and wings were great.  Even better, the server was very attentive to our request.  Fine young college man heading off to the military soon.   Ask for Ray.   Food and service were fantastic!! Bn

The food was great!! The service was ok... We stopped by before the Indy 500 parade and thought we had plenty of time. I ordered a coffee drink from their cocktail menu, but was brought a warm latte with no vodka in it. The server was very apologetic and promptly brought out the correct beverage. I ordered eggs, mushroom and goat cheese. It was delicious. When we were done, we waited quite a while to get our bill and then there was another long wait to get our card back. I would definitely go back, but would make sure we have plenty of time.

Hello everyone, 
I would like you all to know that Flamestones is back open and they have ALL new furniture and decor and most importantly noted, are all set up for fine dining at a distance inside. I visited last night and was soo happy to see my friends Nichola tossin up the fine Liquor and wine behind the bar, Allison serving up the best service at my table and Emil running around over seeing everything from the front of the house to the back so to speak.I had STONE OVEN FLATBREAD WITH STEAK & BLUE CHEESE which was nothing less than Awesome along with a cocktail (or two) from Nick. PLEASE GO and experience yourself. Tell them BOSTON TODD sent ya !

This place is that hole in the wall you've judged by It's outside appearance and kept going..Let me tell you, this is the 3rd, and by far the best BBQ joint we went to this week! I had the pulled pork platter, Sue had the pulled chicken...both were fantastic! We also had their homage Ice cream! The real deal! I will always go to this place when searching for BBQ!

I love their customer service. They have to be the happiest group I ever met. Everyone is so welcoming and so happy which makes me in a good mood. Like who wouldn't want to be in a happy place? 

Their food is also yummy. I ordered the breakfast hash-brown bowl, I think it can feed two. I was only able to finish half. I also got a side of biscuit with gravy. I had two bites I was too full to keep eating lol.

Tried the Metro Diner today and it was fantastic! Great service, great food, and great quantity. Definitely a nice and comfortable family spot to go to. The only thing I suggest for the company is to add the estimated tip percentage amounts  I tipped my server a good amount, but would've loved to tip more if I knew the correct percentages!

Enjoyed Sunday Lunch here during Mardi Gras with some friends and family. This restaurant is huge, but still filled up quickly with reservations. We enjoyed all of the food we got to try, but I must say the appetizers were my favorite (Baked Oysters, Smoked Fish Dip & Yellowfin Tuna Wraps). We were excited to eat somewhere in NOLA that was a bit of a ways away from the French Quarter, so this place was perfect. Plus, it's owned by Emeril Lagasse, so got to check that one of the list!

Excellent chinese , having lived in China the food here is the real deal, not watered down for American tastes. The pepper chicken was excellent! The owner , Joyce is hard working and pleasant , even when busy. We will be back!

I've been driving past this restaurant for weeks now. My girlfriend and I stopped by for lunch on a Sunday as soon as they opened. For appetizers, I ordered tapas. It is essentially small portion appetizers that included chicken satay, egg rolls, spring rolls, and a shrimp shumai. I ordered a massaman curry for my entree. The food was delicious and came out warm. I would definitely visit again to try their noodle dishes or sushi rolls.

I went to Applebee's on last night to pick up my order. I didn't realize when I placed the order online that it was for a different restaurant. The manager was so super nice and accommodating my order quickly and efficiently. The food was wonderful thank you again for everything.

Clean the parking lot of your trash if you want people to eat inside. Good grief this place looks filthy. Walk around and look at the building and ask how clean you think the kitchen is inside. Nasty.
Our dinner tonight was delicious. All the profits went to the Lebanese Red Cross. Our waiter, Ariel, was a delight. And even better was their dessert - Bundino!!!!

First of all I was impressed and thankful that this restaurant had labels on their menu "vegan " ! Thank you for that ! That's amazing that you are considerate of other people's lifestyles. 
I opted for a yummy vegan lentil soup as an appetizer which was absolutely flavorful. And as my entree I had the "Baingan Bharta" which was a 
roasted and  mashed eggplant that was cooked with peas, tomatoes, onions and spices. I opted for spice level 2 which was very good. It was served with rice.  I was hungry when I came and thought I could eat it all but actually did get to go boxes because soup and dish were plentiful for sure .the aroma for both dishes was amazing and I will certainly be back !
Best Chinese food in town. I always order the sweet and sour chicken and house fried rice. Would def recommend to everyone!

Margaritas very good.  Didn't have guacamole the night we went and we were craving some guac!  Had the mofongo with shrimp.  Shrimp was very good but the mofongo was SO heavy.  Had only a few bites before it felt like there was a brick in our stomachs.  Would go back.  Love the authenticness of it.
Delicious food, great service. We eat here all the time. The Brussels sprouts are so amazing!! The atmosphere is cozy and swanky. So glad it's down the street. Go eat here! It's soo yummy!!
Amazing food and great service. Jazz is a great server.  Quality service and confortable tables and great lighting.  Will return.

Our dinner group chose Li'l Abners this past Friday for our meal. We made reservations, so there was no wait to get seated. They had Covid safety processes in place with every other table blocked off, masks for staff & guests, and staying 6 feet apart. It took a few minutes for drink orders to be taken and for us to get drinks. The house margaritas were great ! For some reason, they split our table between 2 servers - one was great the other was very slow and did not work out well at all. Everyone FINALLY did get drinks after half the table waited & waited & waited ! Our orders were taken and again half the table lagged on getting their meals. The food was fantastic - filet, tbone, salmon, chicken - all great !! I'm rating this a 4 - mainly for the food which is a 5, but the service was a 3 at best, maybe a 2 - needs improvement. I'll give li'l Abners another try later, but hoping the service improves. A little pricey, but the steaks are very good !

I went to the 1933 this evening looking forward to my first St. Elmos experience and was more than disappointed by my experience- so much so that I just walked out. I walked in and asked what the wait for 1 was and was told that they were capacity. I was more than happy to leave it at that and try a less busy night although there were others waiting for a table. The host then offered to check the bar  and dragged me through a very busy restaurant that was "at capacity" to show me the bar was full, which was embarrassing. Instead of offering a time for wait or requesting I make a reservation next time she walked away to let me see myself out. I'm externally disappointed and will not be returning. Luckily Fishers is growing, so finding a better establishment is no challenge.

You all blew us away with your incredible food and ambiance! Wow. We had two different types of curry and also had two starters which after we took our first bites were so confused as to how this could be so good.

Thank you for the incredible experience that we will also share with our friends and family.

My only feedback is the service was a bit slow and also we had to remind the waiter twice that we were waiting on food that he thought had already been brought to our table.

My sister and I needed a snack, so we split a pork roll, egg, and cheese on a sesame bagel. It was great. Salty, chewy, tasty, but not too salty and chewy.  The barista accidentally made my sister's latte iced instead of hot, but fixed it no problem and no attitude. I loved that. Thank you.

Great little spot to get a quick dipped cone.  It's cheap, has outdoor seating and great burgers also.  The people working behind the counter are sometimes slow but otherwise they do what they intend to do well.

We love Monday nights here for the $5 burger and fries (or tator tots).  Totally a cool place to grab a bite and watch games.  I'd definitely label it as a sports bar.  The burgers are good, the tator tots and steak fries are awesome and they have a variety of sauces available.  I like it, a lot.  

I just wish the service was up to the same standards.  Each time we visit it seems that we have ehhh service, and we've been multiple times.  We come for the cheap burgers, but don't expect stellar service.  During our last visit, we waited 10 minutes to be served and our waitress acted like she didn't want to be there.  Our bill was messed up and we didn't have drink refilled before we were done with our food.  Maybe this is just on cheap burger nights?

This is the first time I ordered food from this place. Price is decent and the taste is great. They don't have a lot of vegetarian options. I ordered a bulk order for my  work team. Everyone in my team enjoyed the food. We will go to this place again. Currently, they don't offer sit down ag the restaurant. Only take out. They are very conscious about COVID precautions.
They waitress was very kind and helpful explaining the meals as the table didn't know much Italian. The bread was very delicious as well as the pastas.

The building and it's location are the main reasons why many people have passed up on the opportunity to eat at this amazing establishment. This place a hidden gem!!!! I personally had the pulled pork sandwich meal with a side of beans and corn and I was left amazed!!!! One of the best things about this place is their homemade BBQ that completes the whole dish!!! This place does not disappoint!!!! I have some pics attached of when I ordered my meal and an after image!!!

We were there for New Year's Eve and we're thoroughly disappointed with the event put on there, the staff, and the overall organization and hospitality. After hearing many others complaining as well, nothing has been done to resolve any issues and the blame keeps being passed around. Unprofessional.

Great if you're in downtown Clayton and looking for a healthier option at lunch time. They have three main choices: salads, bowls and wraps. The menu offers some specialty combinations of ingredients, but the restaurant is set up like Subway or Chipolte where you can build your own dish. The friendly salad-maker suggested the #10 which had candied pecans and sweet potato wedges, blue cheese and a house made dressing. It was a great choice and I'm now sold on sweet potatoes in a wrap! 

Multiple fresh-brewed iced tea options make my heart full!

Terrible food with all black soy sauce, instead of chop suey wok gravy.
Terrible pork in the sweet n sour pork, was old, dried out, with hard breading like way past leftovers.
Got stomach upset with diareah.
Ordered steamed rice on all dishes, and got fried rice - again old like old left out all day under a light with eggs in it too, could be going bad soon.
Called to tell them, and they said, yeah we know, we are out of white rice, so we are putting fried rice in everything, and did not offer any remedy, they did not mention this when we ordered.
The owner also owns group homes with bedbugs.
Also, they make you put tip on charges up front.

Came here for brunch on a Sunday and it wasn't too busy considering that it was prime brunch time around 11:30-noon. 

The vibe: really open, light atmosphere that feels outdoorsy even inside. Some outdoor seating and lots of natural light inside too so you can enjoy the weather if it's nice outside. 

The food: I got the Thai fried chicken sandwich with fries and my friend got the salad with apples and Dijon mustard. The sandwich was good, the salad was not anything too special but still refreshing! The Thai chicken was very crispy and the slaw was flavorful. I was probably most impressed with the fries; hearty on the inside but crunchy on the outside!

Overall a solid brunch spot! Perhaps if I tried their breakfast options it would movey review to five stars.

Just recently heard about this restaurant and was looking forward to trying it. Went with a group of friends last night and this place is. A vegan lovers heaven! The food was super gourmet yet homestyle Mexican fare with a bunch of other comfort food choices like Mac-n-cheese and faux meat Sammy's. Fresh kombucha on tap. Highly recommend the jungle tamale . Beautiful decor and ambience with reggae vibes. A place you can bring your lady or get down with the boys. Family vibes. 100% Plant-based. A must try (and I'm a super picky Vegan chef)
Tons of employees wearing their masks below their chin... And this pic of one that worked around food the entire time with no mask!!!
Love this place.  Great Italian food.  We usually get the Franchaise or Saltimbuca but have had Half the menu & love it all
Love this place is one of the best gyro spots in  city Hands down I recommend you try to Philly Cheese steak and their Italian beef sandwich and don't forget the Gyro

Delicious!  My girlfriend and I came here without reading reviews because it was conveniently located and it looked local enough to be good. We were not disappointed. 

The good:
- fried fish (oh those seasonings)
- fried shrimp 
- french fries (in Los Angeles we would call these "seasoned fries")
- po boy 
- banana pudding
- oddly nice restroom 

The damn good:
- the tartar sauce made me update this review because I almost forgot to mention it. It's homemade and leveled up the whole experience 

The not so good:
- don't come for the ambiance

Enjoy!

Visited this place tonight with family. The atmosphere is fun. They have a wide variety of drinks to pick from. The menu had good choices as well. I ordered the Alfredo & it was delicious, but I now have a horrible HORRIBLE stomach ache

Was glad to have this pace recommended by a friend. Everything was really tasty, and our waitress was attentive and helpful with menu questions. There were also clear safety signage and practices in place. We had the jackfruit lettuce cups to share, and I loved the gluten free banana pancakes on the brunch menu. The cocktails were really fresh and reflected summer flavors and produce. I had the honeydew melon margarita - fabulous! This place is a bit pricey for lunch/brunch - $120 for 3 plus tip.

La Super-Rica is a legend, with good reason - fun, casual spot for excellent Mexican food and, as others have said, beloved by Julia Child. I get hungry just seeing the seafoam green trim when driving up Milpas.

My favorites on the menu are the tacos de bistec, rajas, guacamole, quesadilla, chile relleno and super-rica especial. And horchata!

This place is quintessentially California.

Made my burger wrong and when I called I was told I could bring it back and they could make me a new one. Great, so while my family is eating I can be driving around town. That was all they said they could do for me, $12 down the drain. We will not be going back.

I had my first Brew Bus experience on a quiet Sunday. I was craving something savory. After my friend told me about Brew Bus' chicken sandwich, I hopped on Yelp to see if there were any photos to be found. Alas, I peeped the goods, and things appeared seemingly sufficient. 

I split the chicken sandwich with my girlfriend and it was perfect. Between the sauce, bun, coleslaw, chicken and seasoning, everything was on point. The fries were amazing too! 

We also got Brew Bus' Thurman Burman beer which was incredible. Super fruity and juicy tasting. 

A very cleanly, friendly environment at this place. I'll definitely be back!

Horrible experience. The seafood tasted old and mushy. I want to believe they are not serving fresh seafood but serving leftovers instead. The oysters were almost burnt, shrimp were mushy and the fish was overcooked. The pasta tasted watered down. Why are they even open? The place looks like a dungeon. They don't have anywhere where to watch football. My husband was disgusted i chose this place for our wedding anniversary.

Notably: their servers were outstanding. 
If they called Gordon Ramsey, I'm assured he'd provide tips to keep the business alive.

Wow, I am so glad our reservation across the street somehow got canceled because it allowed us to  eat here. Everything was delicious. Best crab cake in Nashville( probably top 3 in my life) We had the 3 cheese tortellini (amazing), mushroom ravioli (spectacular), and the strawberry tiramisu(divine). I can not wait until my next visit!
Great Wings and friendly service.  It's not what I expected. It kind of a college bar, but the food and service were great.

This place was recommended by a friend. We liked it so much we ate there two out of the four days we were in New Orleans (wanted to go another morning but it was raining cats and dogs). The wife ordered the southern breakfast and she loved it all. The breakfast potatoes were delicious and she loved the fried green tomato. I ordered the breakfast sandwich with bacon and pepper jack cheese. The best part was the bun that it was made with. The iced coffee was great as well as the mimosas. The staff was friendly and was nice in making recommendations due to it being our first visit. We has to visit this location due to the others being closed due to COVID. We ended up walking there and it was a nice scenery change and got to see some different parts of New Orleans. Needless to say it was a 1.8 mile walk from our hotel and it was worth every step.

Food was not bad, but not recommended when lines are long if you are super hungry because you may not get your food for up to an hour. Service staff is not savvy enough to bring out food as each dish is ready, so it may help to order beignets separately from other dishes. When we finally got our food, service staff (lady with long hair who was also our cashier) muttered, "This ain't McDonalds." Two stars for service and attitude, food was otherwise fine.

Tried this place and the double espresso was perfect! I had waffles because I was short on time and the friendly clerk said they were the fastest to make. They were surprisingly filling for what I first thought was a small portion. Can't want to try the pancakes next time!

Great service and great food!! Turkey wings, curry anything, mac and cheese, fish, all delicious!!! Prices are reasonable and did I mention the service is excellent. The potato salad was ok but the curry chicken and cabbage was great!!

Made a birthday reservation to this restaurant. When I showed up they told us there was an hour wait and that they didn't honor our reservation. I showed the worker the receipt for my calls and reservation and she literally sent us away. Terrible customer service and this was my first time here. Do not book special events here.

Very comfortable dining room, chicken and waffles were amazing! 50% seating capacity and 1 hour max time limit which was nice because we didn't have to wait for a table. Loved that they served coffee in larger mugs and have fresh squeezed OJ...hey, its the little things!

Really really love this place. BEST burger in the city. Not Port of Call. Yeah. I said it. 
This place could be called divey but it's really just laid back. That have a long bar with lots of seating, a few high top tables, maybe six booths, and then outdoor seating. Plenty of space to spread out with COVID. Lots of cold beers on tap and friendly service. Great place to watch a football game.

I was pleasantly surprised ...was so afraid it was going to be like a fast food chain. 
The staff was courteous. The food was great

Since we moved to Arizona we haven't found good Italian.  I was hoping this would be my announcement proclaiming we had finally experienced an Italian masterpiece.  We noticed the restaurant after an appointment in the area a few weeks ago.  My mother visited so my son, she and I visited for lunch.  My son ordered a turkey panini and thought it was good.  He was disappointed he couldn't order pizza.  I ordered lasagna and my mother ordered fettuccine alfredo.  My mother order minestrone but received a salad.  The salad was fresh, decent but nothing special.  The alfredo sauce was watery.  The lasagna was no better than Stouffers...the sauce and meat were bland.  The bread and olive oil were delicious.  The gentleman who served us was pleasant.  The restaurant is small but it's nicely decorated and very clean but I have no desire to go back to spend $40 on food I don't enjoy.

Lanima was delicious. We started with the grilled octopus and I had nero di sepia (squid ink pasta) My date had the vaccinate (pappardelle with boar). 

I would have to say polpo app was my favorite and I could have enjoyed that as a meal! The pasta was good but turned my mouth black! (This was a first date so it was a bit awkward, save that dish for not a date). I would not order it again aside from my mouth turning black. Next time I would try the pesto. That looked fabulous! The pappardelle was delicious and the boar provided some great flavor. The pasta was delicious in both dishes and tasted homemade which is key. 

For dessert we had the cannoli and some gelato. The dessert was fabulous and presentation was gorgeous. 

Our waiter whose name I forget was amazing. He was very personable and provided great recommendations. He was from NC if you go in ask for the waiter from NC. 

Lanima is also BYOB!
Coffee like no other,  will be back tomorrow.  There is no reason for me to stir the pot and look any further,  amazing coffee and donuts.

Best Pot sticker hands-down. I enjoy the dipping sauce more than most places that have potstickers. The service is always friendly and if you are unsure what to get, the owner/manager is always helpful in making recommendations. One note, he does not take price into consideration, So if price is an issue, make sure you ask how much the dish he is recommending is... LOL.

We usually order the softshell crab in Ginger and Garlic, potstickers, house fried rice, house fried noodles (chow fun, chow mein), Steamed Chinese broccoli, generals chicken, 1/2 Peking duck, preserved duck eggs with tofu, sliced pork with mustard green soup, Salt and pepper fish or pork.

I do really enjoy the food here, it is quite authentic. However for the price, I do believe that the portions are kind of small. At some other authentic Chinese restaurants, we usually order between 6 to 10 dishes to have a good variety, and didn't have enough left over for the dinner the next day for my family of seven. However here the food is usually all gone. So, we don't visit here often as I have a Large family to feed. When we go to a Chinese restaurant and spend $120, it is nice to know that I'm having dinner for two nights LOL. If portion size is not an issue for you, the food here is really good.

This is the place I had my first po-boy when it was in a building just feet away from the current location. My father took me to the place and I thought this is heavenly!

The new location is the result of Hurricane Katrina and the subsequent levee failures and flooding. 

The owners had serious resolve and opened it up and re-located and opened Rock n' Bowl (a bowling lane that  regularly has amazing local talent). 

The food - there's nothing not amazing. Of course try the po-boy sandwich, dressed. But hey if you're a sandwich person there's plenty of yum.

The bar is fully stocked and the bartenders are good and as you frequent it, you'll understand it's a neighborhood place.

Support the locals and enjoy and most likely you'll find the owners there with you.

WOW! What a great sandwich place. Everything from the food to the service deserves five stars. 

Started with the Platano Maduros and already I was blown away. They were cooked perfectly, and in an air fryer no less. I also had the Cuban sandwich and red beans and rice. Both delicious but I just could not get enough of the red beans and rice. They were just spicy enough to enjoy and not hate your life because it's too spicy. I could live off those beans and rice. 

The prices are reasonable, the food is fantastic and the service was above and beyond. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Great new spot for tacos, bowls, burritos.  Excellent kids menu as well.  Highly recommend!

Food is great but the service is very poor and management doesn't take constructive criticism well. We dined there two weeks ago on the patio and not a single employee was wearing a mask. Every other restaurant in town they are wearing masks and often latex gloves. I will not go back u til covid 19 is a thing of the past. This is so irresponsible on the managements part. When I wrote them a very polite email I was told I could have asked for a server with a mask. Really?! I shouldn't have to ask. That means no one in the kitchen is following safe procedures either. Done at your own peril.

Finall ordered food from firkin tavern OMG  Order direct- they deliver.  Mozzarella en Carozza burger (fried mozzarella burger) to die for. Pepperoni, cheese, marinara, happiness. Bacon cheeseburger with bacon actually cooked into the meat.. Poutine tater tots! Whaaat?! Delish. And the wings were insane- old bay & garlic. Def recommend. Looking forward to the end of Covid when we can go there in person!!

Do you like beer? Are you an indecisive drinker? Well, Oak & Stone is the perfect spot for you. Why, you ask? Well - in this adult dave-and-busters style spot you get a wrist band which allows you to pour as much or as little as you would like from their draft beer selection wall.

They've got all sorts of options - from stouts, to ales, to IPA - you get the picture. And the best part, it's pretty damn cheap to sip your way through the good stuff. A group of three of us went for a couple beers on a Saturday afternoon and I don't think we spent more than $10 on a beer and a half each.

Oak & Stone also has food, but we didn't opt to eat on our visit. Pizza looked yummy tho. 

Service was a little slow, but I imagine it's because they knew we weren't eating and the beer is serve yourself.

If you're looking for great Mexican food at a reasonable price, look no further, give Taqueria la Flama a try! We've enjoyed everything we tried! Our favorite dishes are: the carnitas plate, the menudo & the birria de res (beef chunks in a delicious broth) all served with homemade corn tortillas! They also have a salsa bar! So good! Give it a try!

Although I live a few minutes away, I'm surprised I've never tried this place out. I guess maybe the name seems a bit generic. But was pleasantly surprised at the food and quality of the sushi here.  Would definitely come back and order again.

Edessa is honestly so good. Everything there tastes nothing short of amazing. I got the salmon dinner and my fiancé got the chicken skewers. Taste was phenomenal and you could tell that these people knew their stuff. Even the presentation was amazing. I honestly can't say more than I loved it.

Great ambiance , food and cocktails. 
What more could you want? 
Centrally loctaed, they have indoor and outdoor eating and an unbeatable energy. 
I will definitely be back!!!

We had been on the different "Ijji" in town, our fav is the Ijji 4 until this one opens up.  The first week they pre-open, we tried them right away.  I had the "Bulgogi" with steam rice and my Significant other had the "black garlic ramen".  The staff and of course, the manager/owner Kurt were very please to see us, we have been acquainted since we visit Ijji4 a whole lot.  They are as always very attentive and accommodating.  The next week we came in I wanted to try their Combination "Pho" and My husband their "O.G. Ramen", needless to say my husband loves Ramen. So on the same week, I tried their "poke bowl" and once again a Ramen(Shoyu Chicken Ramen)  for my spouse.  The three time that we went were very satisfactory.  The Ramen that we had, the Poke bowl and the Pho soup were the best I have tasted in town, not to mention they have a full bar to offer.  Love this place and I really like the staff.

Yelp was a big help today! So many restaurants in the Quarter, how could I decide?! The photos sold me on the diversity of offerings at Cafe Conti. First you will notice the air conditioning, a life saver on a humid day. The service was great and the coffee tasty. The grits bowl was better than I could have imagined! Nothing wrong about this place. Try it you'll like it?

Pizza is good crispy no burnt thin crust burgers are good can be cooked to the temp of your preference.  The wings are absolute TRASH they are precooked pre breaded seasoned wings that they toss in the fryer and add their sauce to them.  Whatever you do if you enjoy a good buffalo style wing avoid this place.  The prices are kind of high also almost 9 bucks for two slices of pizza and no drink.

I order food couple times there and always are so late . Waited  outside because the civis 2019 and went inside simple like that ,didn't don't care if the client is wait or need to go back to work.  Always call with a lot advanced. I forgot about this place . They don't need respect or more clients .
This is the spot!! Love the food here and the staff is very friendly. Spot on service as well. The red salsa  keep up the great food and great customer service guys!!

I have been going to and loving Nu Yalk Pizza since they opened in 1978 in what was then called the Gemco Shopping Center, where Sportsman's Warehouse is now. When they opened they called themselves New York Pizza, not Nu Yalk.  After some years they moved across Kietzke on the SW Corner at Moana into a converted original format 7/11 convenience store that was taken by the City to widen Moana along with several other buildings on the South side of Moana from the SW corner of So. Virginia and Moana east to the Freeway.

For a number of years I operated a Retail store in fairly close proximity. We ordered Pizza for lunch as much as three times a week and sometimes dart out for a slice or two.

I always told people that New York Pizza was the best pizza in town.

Funny story, I used to work with a young lady, a new arrival to the States from Japan, I recommended NY to her. I asked her how it was? She said they had bad service. I laughed and said, they don't have bad service, they have no service, there is a difference LOL, it is a self-service type place... She liked the pizza.

Well... The last three times in a row, over as many months, that I have dropped in for a slice (I can't eat two anymore) the pie has been burnt. Mind you, I don't mean a burn spot here and there on the bottom of the crust which is fine and normal. There has been a distinct BURNT flavor permeating each bite. The first time it happened I just went with it thinking, hey things happen... The next (second) ti
What can I say that has not been said... Mazzaro's Italian Market rocks! a true St pete gem

Boca used to be our go to place. We would find a way to take friends and visitors from out of town. Last visit, which was almost a year ago was for my birthday and the food & as well as the service has gone downhill. Meals were subpar & not hot. My MIL'a meal was the Ruben flatbread & the pastrami was overcooked, dry & not edible. Server only came by after food was served. We did express disappointment to our server and manager came by to apologize, replace the meal, but at this point the rest of the party was done eating. She passed & it was removed from the bill. We normally stay for dessert, but we cut our visit short. I can see by other reviews, it's has not gotten better. 

Sad, because this place was a great, higher end restaurant without having to drive into downtown Tampa.

Disappointed.
I've been to Zona 78 a handful of times, it's good food, nothing out of this world good and kind of high priced, (In my opinion) but good. Servers have always been fine. 
However the other evening I went and ordered a pizza to go. They told me it would be ready in about 10-15 minutes. I waited in my car for about 30 minutes before they finally called me to tell me it was ready. I would have understood if it was busy at the time, but there were maybe 8 customers total. ( it was a Monday around 4) 
Then to top it off I opened the box when I got in my car and it was luke warm at best. 
I basically paid 20 dollars for a Luke warm pizza. It was so disappointing. I wouldn't recommend them for take out. But I do think the are okay when dinning in.

I have lived in jersey along time and still miss philly pizza, however this place because of wood fired brick oven has made me love jersey pizza! The fries are not greasy or salty and tasty. The Syrian food choices are authentic and very good. The ingredients and meats are top choices,they believe good food starts with the freshest and best ingredients. The restaurant is clean and bright if you choose to eat there. I live in Marlton but worth the 26 min drive. Give it a try you won't be disappointed. I'm not a relative and I was not encouraged to write this I truly enjoyed the place!

Creamed chipped beef- no beef or flavor ,all flour. 
Potatoes- dry, under cooked 
Asked for crispy bacon- wilted
Grits- under cooked and watery 
Roll- dry. Seamed to be day old. 
I gave them many chances, never again.

I would give it a no stars if possible. Went there and they would not serve without wearing a mask even though is an outdoor area. My mother in law put a shirt all around her face and they still told her NO! Then they told her she could purchase a mask from them for $1.50 which she agreed but they wanted her to make two transactions such BS. They lost out business that day and it was for 12 people. That's okay we then walked a few blocks and sat outdoors and ordered Mexican food without a mask and had some margaritas yum! Will not go back.

Lots of great places to eat in Ambler these days - but this is the go-to coffee/bakery. But amazing sandwiches and other "gourmet cafe" brunch/lunch-type fare. 
Super friendly staff.

Have eaten at terakawa for a while (before pandemic) and they've always provided a delicious meal. Their quality, flavors are always consistent. Their ramen and rice balls remind me of Japan. their pork buns are also delicious

I have tried pretty much everything on the menu and it has all tasted great. The staff are super friendly - they have remembered me since my second visit and always wish me a nice day. The granola is nice if you want a light breakfast - it is the perfect sweetness for me and has my favorite fruits. The Benedict's are yummy and very filling. The salads are tasty and the chicken always seems very fresh and well cooked. Sometimes you have to wait more than at other places, but I think that is because they cook every from scratch when you order so the quality is better and it is worth the wait!
Though not exactly healthy it's got better chicken than the other drive thrus. Sometimes you got to do it. Quick takeout.

Garbage. All meat was cold. Shrimp taco had about 4 table spoon full of nasty orange suace that didn't let you taste anything else but the sauce. Go down the street to Del Taco you will save money and get better quality tacos.

Smoked fish dip was very tasty, not a lot of mayonnaise and served with fancy seeded crackers. Creole egg rolls were delish. Sad I only got a half cuz we split the dish.  The waiter recommended what he called The Tremendous Caesar Salad- with anchovies. It was very good. 

For dinner I had a New York strip, done to perfection. And a side of mushrooms- I wish I could get that recipe! And the coconut basmati rice was subtle and yummy.  

Apparently, this restaurant used to be a breakfast place, so they kept one of their favorite pancakes as a dessert, a berry and whipped cream fluffy delight! The pineapple upside down cake was served warm. It was also very yummy.  

This restaurant has made it to my Clearwater list of favorites!
Nice little coffee shop. All outside seating and friendly staff! Cute little tasty egglet's for a quick breakfast!

This place was good, but when I ordered a Bobby Flay burger I expected Bobby Flay to deliver it personally. When I chose to eat at this establish, I was told it was a palace and that Bobby Flay was the prince of the palace. I was looking forward to seeing him in his chef hat, and long red robe. Like in my dreams
Ordered the grandma pizza and it was out of this world.  We can't wait to try everything else on the menu especially the rice balls.  You can tell they use top notch ingredients for their pizzas.

Yuuuum! First time eating Tony's pizza palace today and it was exactly as one reviewer described: plain pizza - chewy / crunchy crust, great sauce to cheese ratio. Very good and I'm excited to keep eating here !

I don't know what these people are talking about. I stay st the hotel at least 10 times a year and eat in the cafe or rim. The service is excellent and the staff are are wonderful. The good is excellent if you order correctly after all it's a cafe.
Great cocktails! Amazing atmosphere. The outdoor seats are very comfortable and the staff was super nice!

Today was my husband and my first time at this location we usually go to the one on meridian road, and I have to say it was so delicious. I had the cinnamon French toast and my husband had chicken fried steak both were outstanding. My husband ordered a vanilla iced mocha and he didn't care for it he said it was watery and didn't taste much like coffee but other than that we left totally satisfied

Chef Daniel prepared an amazing meal, from appetizers to dessert. We tried a little bit of several items from the cauliflower to dessert and We loved it all. Steak was far better than the steak I had recently at Berns steakhouse and calamari was some of the best I've had. I finished off with the chocolate mousse/pudding and it was perfection. We will be back!

Worst service I've ever had or seen. If you wanna be ignored for 20 mins and sprayed in the face with key beer without an apology sit at the bar. I work in the service industry so I have a lot of patience. If I could give it zero I would. The manager could care less also. So we left and went to O sushi.

Aunties biscuits meets expectations as far as soul food is concerned. But the biscuits take them over the ledge. I've never had a biscuit like theirs before and I would return just for them! When I visited, I tried the stuffed salmon with Mac and yams. Classic combo so I couldn't wait to dive in (hence the lack of pictures)! As mentioned, the yams and Mac are consistent. The salmon though had a very unique flavor. I'm no chef but it had heavy accents of Dijon or maybe horseradish. Since I'm not a fan of either I didn't enjoy it as much but I will return to try other items.

Tried this little gem on a date night with my husband. Fantastic dinner! We usually share a few items so that we can try several things. Once the food arrived there was very little talking aside from "mmmmm" and "damn this is good!" I highly recommend it!!

The coffee was great, this is definitely a decent place if you want to grab a good cup. The food was well made and had good flavor but the menu is incredibly small and everything is a bit pricey. The service made me feel weird and often felt pretentious. There are plenty of better brunch spots in the area, go to one of those instead.

I don't think you can ever go wrong with Chili's. I find it a great place to bring the whole family, or for a quick happy hour. 

If you sign up for their club card, you get FREE chips and salsa, and they always email coupons for FREE dessert or appetizer. 

Every month they offer a different $5 margarita. 

My go to item here is definitely their fajita's. What's great is that they have a dinner for 2 for $25, which includes appetizer, dessert and 10 meal items you can choose from, including the chicken fajitas. 

I gave this location 3 stars, because I find that every time we come here, we have to wait awhile, before the server greats us. Otherwise, I would have given them a solid 4 star review.

I am a big fan of all the Ciccio Restaurant Group restaurants. I find their flavor profiles to be really great and the menus are always exciting. One of my favorite things is that they clearly mark all Gluten Free items on the menu and I don't have to ask for a special one. I love the fiesta bowls and loco nachos. They also have really great drinks. It does get quite loud in here, so it's not the place for a romantic date night, but it's the perfect place to kick off a fun night out!
One of the better cheese steaks I had on my trip to Philly. It was cooked perfect and it's a great place for a grab and go.

We just got a catered meal at my business from Moccia's, and it was delicious!! 2 different Zitis, chicken cheesesteaks, regular cheesesteaks, hoagies, and fixin's! The rolls were wonderful! Well done and thank you for the fantastic meal!! I'm looking forward to visiting your establishment with my wife in the near future!
Very good Thai food and friendly staff. I will go here often.  Nice to see a place like this out here in Spanish Springs.

Amazing NY style pizza! We just moved here from NY 3months ago and just assumed that good pizza was just up north- Not the case!! My husband is very particular about good pizza, as soon as he took a bite he said "We found our pizza place down here!" 
Make sure that you order at least an hour in advance especially on the weekends as they are very busy- try it, you won't be disappointed

People who don't give this place a 5 star review are crazy. 
The pizza, the price?
You guys' fave place is prolly Domino's.
Man the breakfast sandwiches great!!! I really enjoyed the Scrapple sandwich. They're all good size so you won't walk away hungry. Just wish they were open more

Has to be one of the best barbecue places in the nation, pulled pork, chicken dinner, and their sides are amazing.  One suggestion, I wish they had mac & cheese, if they did I would eat there twice a week.  Local family place, very casual, right by the trail. Staff are always friendly and helpful
This place is awesome! Food, service, cleanliness are all awesome. I can't wait for the buffet to reopen!

This place is really good.  I eat here at least 2 times a week with the Family.  We're doing to-go now with the restrictions but it's the families go to when we don't feel like cooking.  If you're in the area try them out.  I usually get the Hibachi.
Bushfire sandwich is sooooooooo DANK
I tried  The food always smells like old socks. It looks so delicious, they have such a great menu and I've tried multiple times! I just can't get past the smell.

Not a bad thai restaurant, just not the best. The Pad see ew was okay. It was not as much flavor as I would've liked. There are many other better Thai food restaurants in town if you are looking for something more authentic. The food was decent, but I do not see myself returning.

Some of the BEST fish in STL. Mac & cheese, sweet potatoes were delicious! Hubby also had old bay seasoning chicken which was great.... you can't go wrong if you are looking for some good soul food like grandma used to make

I'm very surprised by the negative reviews on both food and service. Mh mom and I are major foodies and this is our favorite spot for Sunday Brunch! I've been here many times, both at this location and the one in Warrington and have had nothing but great experiences. 

I definitely recommend calling ahead to check I'm wait times or make a reservation since they're always packed regardless of what it says on yelp.

Their coffee is excellent and they've got lots of fun flavored lattes and oil scented French press coffee. Service is usually excellent though when they are really slammed it can be on the slower end. But the waiters and waitresses are always so friendly, accommodating and apologetic if they're extremely busy.


I got the I Can't Believe They're Vegan Pancakes and couldn't agree more with the name. They were delicious and definitely didn't taste like they were missing eggs or buttermilk. So yummy! My favorite thing to order here is the Big Easy Benedict. It's delicious with the cornbread! Other great menu items are Grande Huevos Rancheros, Salted Caramel Waffle, Tuscany Omelette, and and their El Fresco Quinoa Bowl. And my go to latte is the Nutty Irishman. 

Highly recommend you give this place a shot just be sure to call ahead and expect it to be busy!

We had dinner from Thai Table togo a week or two ago.  It was some of the best food eaten in a while!  They were very clean and friendly. I would love try a meal inside when available. Hope this restaurant remains open during this time!

This place is delicious! They are so caring and kind, especially Adam, he's the best!! They are open through all of this and are doing all they can to help their community. I had the smoked wings which were fabulous!  I can tell they go to extensive measures to give the best service around.
I went there for my bar crawl on St. Patrick's weekend. It was my first stop on the bar crawl. It was dope and the vibe is good. I never tried its food but the drinks were decent.

This is for sure my new go-to in Manayunk. As a first timer at The Couch Tomato Bistro/Cafe, I can say that I enjoyed every last bite. When we first arrived, e the waitress served us complimentary shooters of tomato bisque and it was a tasty start to our meal. I was a little hesitant to get the Grilled Salmon Salad due to me trying something a little out of my comfort zone but it was absolutely delicious. It was paired with this buttery vinaigrette that was to die for. It was cool to find out that this place is also all about making everything fresh & catering to ALL allergies. If you need a healthy tasty meal, definitely check them out!

Moved here 2 weeks ago and have eaten here 3x. The fish is super fresh and the rolls are super tasty. Every encounter I've had with their staff has been so refreshing as they're genuinely excited for your patronage. I LOVE the Go Green Roll and the spicy tuna roll. The organic salmon nigiri is dreamy too. Best sushi in Santa Barbara thus far- I've tried Arigoto and sushi Kai.

Hands down to the best K BBQ in Philadelphia area. The quality of meat is really good, and the soup is also delicious. Friendly customer service. No more hustling to NYC for Korean BBQ. It's worth a visit if you are craving for good quality meat.

I gave them 5 stars on other dishes. But the crawfish is a rip off. No meat at all just juice. And over boiled tuff if your lucky to get a meaty one. I think they are frozen . Junk. Don't get anything with crawfish. If they keep this up they will go down. Foodie here. They count on there sauce.witch is good.
